question: How much did The Farmer Companies raise in its latest funding round?

hits.title: Rising cheese snack producer hires new CEO.
hits.snippet: [invests_into | 2026-07-01 | $17 million] AJAX Capital Partners invested into The Farmer Companies, Inc. $17M in Series A on Jul 1st '26. The Farmer Cos. closed $17 million of Series A financing, led by Raff Ventures and AJAX Capital Partners, in July, which will be used to support continued investment in manufacturing partnerships, national distribution and strategic acquisitions.
hits.summary: AJAX Capital Partners invested into The Farmer Companies, Inc. $17M in Series A on Jul 1st '26.
